title: Preview route health projects full AccessibleSummary (name + state + boundary detail)
what_it_proves: ExpertSurfaceModel.RouteHealthAccessibleSummary composes 'name：state。detail' per card with the same prefix/empty-snapshot wording as DesktopCompat; ApplyRouteHealth raises change notification so bindings refresh.
DesktopCompat renders _routes.Text directly from RouteHealthAccessibleSummary instead of Name/StateLabel fragments.
Compatibility Preview exposes a read-only route status TextBlock bound to Expert.RouteHealthAccessibleSummary with AutomationProperties.Name='路由健康狀態摘要'.
control-model-check asserts the composed summary includes full boundary detail for both snapshot cards.
winui-shell-check fails closed if either preview stops referencing Expert.RouteHealthAccessibleSummary.
limitations: Source-level and contract-model evidence only; no screen-reader/UIA runtime session was exercised.
No physical audio, driver install/load, HLK or Microsoft signing claim.
